title: Frontend Developer (Angular & React)
description:
Frontend Developer (Angular & React) 
 Role: Frontend Developer (Angular & React) Experience: 3+ Years 
 Location : Mangalore Work Mode: Work From Office (Mangalore) 
 Job Summary 
 We are looking for a skilled Frontend Developer with hands-on experience in Angular and/or React (Next.js) to build scalable, secure, and high-performance websites / web applications. The role involves working on public-facing marketing websites, enterprise SaaS products, admin portals and, in close collaboration with backend, DevOps, and product teams. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Develop and maintain enterprise-grade websites / web applications using Angular/ React.js Build SEO-friendly and high-performance user interfaces using React.js / Next.js Design reusable, modular, and maintainable UI components Integrate frontend applications with Node.js REST APIs Implement authentication, authorization, and role-based access control Ensure responsive design, cross-browser compatibility, and performance optimization Follow frontend security and coding best practices Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and technical discussions Collaborate closely with designers, product managers, and backend teams 
 Required Skills 
 Strong hands-on experience in at least one frontend framework : Angular or React Willingness and ability to work on both Angular and React projects as per business needs Proficiency in TypeScript Experience with REST API integration Solid understanding of HTML5, CSS3, SCSS Experience with UI frameworks such as Angular Material, Tailwind CSS, or similar Version control using Git Strong debugging and problem-solving skills Experience with Next.js (SSR / SSG) and SEO optimization Angular Universal (SSR) State management (RxJS, Signals, NgRx, Redux) Experience deploying frontend apps on AWS Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines Knowledge of OAuth, JWT-based authentication
